title: happi Totem
description: Adds the 7TV Emote "happi" as a totem of undying
body: This texture pack replaces the Totem of Undying with the iconic 7TV emote Happi. Now whenever you clutch a near-death moment, you’ll be saved by pure happi energy. Perfect for streamers and emote enjoyers who want a little more personality (and meme power) in their survival world.
